notes.title: Optimization Update 1: March 22, 2022
notes.content:
This update marks the start of optimizations and fixes for Irene.House.

In this Build:
Updated visibility of first level
Offloaded unused assets


Coming later:
New User Manual
Attempts at further reducing file size and stability

notes.title: Update Notes for Dec 13
notes.content:
Fixed fatal load error.

Added new viewpoint in car level, removed some blocking volumes.

notes.title: Update Notes for November 21
notes.content: Added gallery installation which can be accessed by pressing "g" on the first level. Gallery installation is based on a real-life exhibition at the LaVerne Krause Gallery (Eugene, OR), which ran Nov 15-18, 2021.
